audit.title: Line-by-line audit
audit.subtitle: Every line checked against ATS parsing, LLM screening and what a recruiter sees in the first eight seconds.
audit.runningHint: Reading your CV line by line…
audit.allClear: Nothing to fix — this CV reads clean.
audit.offlineHint: The AI layer is off, so you're seeing the checks that can be proven from the document itself. Positioning and phrasing advice needs an AI key.
audit.applyAllTitle: Shows exactly what would change before anything is applied. Covers only the fixes with one correct answer — dates, capitalization, link format; wording stays yours.

missingLocation.title: No location anywhere in the CV
missingLocation.reason: An ATS geo-filter can't match you and a recruiter doesn't know your timezone — it's their first question. Add a city and whether you're open to remote.

currentRoleNotPresent.title: Your current job looks like you've left it
currentRoleNotPresent.reason: The end date is this month or later, so both a recruiter and a screening model read this as a past role. "Present" removes the ambiguity.

yearsMismatch.title: Your years of experience contradict your own dates
yearsMismatch.reason: The summary claims a different number from what the job periods add up to. A model that checks dates catches this and trusts your other figures less.

clicheOpener.title: The summary opens with a cliché
clicheOpener.reason: This is the most valuable line in the CV and the first words carry no information. Open with the role, the years and your strongest concrete fact.

linkUrlsNotInText.title: Your links won't survive PDF parsing
linkUrlsNotInText.reason: The address exists only as a clickable annotation — a parser reading the text finds the word "LinkedIn" and no URL. Printing the address itself fixes it.

atsRiskTemplate.title: This template splits the page into columns
atsRiskTemplate.reason: Multi-column layouts scramble the reading order for text extraction, so bullets can end up detached from the job they belong to. A single-column template parses reliably.

noSeniorityInTitle.title: No seniority in your title
noSeniorityInTitle.reason: Your own dates support a senior-level title, and without the word a screening model tends to classify the CV as mid-level.

entryWithoutBullets.title: This job has no bullets at all
entryWithoutBullets.reason: There's nothing here for an ATS to match or a recruiter to read — the role is invisible beyond its dates.

unquantifiedJob.title: This job has no numbers in it
unquantifiedJob.reason: Not every line needs a figure, but a whole role without one gives a screener nothing concrete to hold onto.

overlongBullet.title: This bullet is too long to scan
overlongBullet.reason: Past roughly 45 words a bullet stops being read in a six-second scan. Split it or cut the qualifiers.

inconsistentRoleCaps.title: Role capitalization doesn't match your header
inconsistentRoleCaps.reason: Your header is Title Cased and this role isn't — small, but it's the kind of inconsistency a careful reader notices.

universityTypo.title: Misspelled university name
universityTypo.reason: The official spelling is "Polytechnic". A typo in the name of your own university reads as carelessness if a recruiter checks it.
